answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable bond before it can vouch for another agent, and slash that bond if the vouched agent is later proven fake. One operator running a thousand sock puppets must fund each one, so a sybil swarm gets expensive fast while honest agents keep their stake. Like a summit climb, each member carries their own pack, and an echo of misconduct follows the whole rope team — a sable mark on the record that a fresh identity cannot wash away.
